About Emirates Financial Towers:
Emirates Financial Towers is a commercial Grade A twin-tower in Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The twin tower has 27 storey above the ground which is connected with a glass sky bridge. Its buildings are named North Tower and South Tower. There is an area of 658,030 sq. ft. for Grade A offices, while 97,000 sq. ft. are dedicated for retail spaces. It has easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro.

About DIFC:
Dubai International Financial Centre is an urban landmark where individuals and corporations come to advance their business, engage with the community and experience the energy of the central business district. Designed as a ‘city within a city’, it provides a complete range of business and lifestyle facilities for today’s professionals such as ultra-modern office space, retail outlets, restaurants, art galleries, hotels and residential apartments.

About Engel & Völkers:
Engel & Völkers is one of the world’s leading service companies specializing in the brokerage of residential and commercial properties, yachts and aviation, with 1000 offices in over 30 countries.
